userStories.title: Import a Guide and read it in the Guide window
userStories.description: Tracer bullet through every layer. The ImportParser reads the `!guide v1` header and free-form Sections (Talents and Rotation are kept as plain Sections for now). `/guide import` opens the ImportBox. Pasting and clicking Import stores the Guide in the account-wide library, makes it the character's Active guide, and shows an import result. `/guide` toggles the Guide window: header (title, Variant, author, updated) plus a Section list and content pane showing paragraphs, bullets and numbered lists as written. Labels live in the locale file.
acceptanceCriteria: ImportParser rejects a missing or unknown version line, and missing title/variant/class/url, with line numbers
Free-form Sections keep their order and text
Import stores the Guide in FieldGuideDB and sets the Active guide in FieldGuideCharDB
Import result shows title, Variant and Section count
Guide window shows the header and switches Sections from the list
`/guide`, `/guide import` and `/guide help` work
Unit tests and the smoke test pass

userStories.title: Copy box for the Source page link
userStories.description: A link button in the Guide window header opens the Copy box with the Source page URL selected for Ctrl+C. Bare URLs inside Section text are shown as clickable links that open the same Copy box.
acceptanceCriteria: Link button opens the Copy box with the full URL highlighted and focused
Esc or clicking away closes it
URLs in Section text are detected (Markup) and clickable
Tests cover URL detection; smoke test opens the Copy box

userStories.title: Guide library: re-import, delete and choosing a Guide
userStories.description: Guides are identified by Source page URL + Variant. Re-importing the same pair replaces the Guide in place and the import result says Updated with the old and new dates. The Guide window lists library Guides (the character's class first), lets the character pick its Active guide, and deletes a Guide after an in-addon confirm. A character without an Active guide is offered Guides of its class.
acceptanceCriteria: Same URL + Variant replaces, different Variant adds
Import result says Added or Updated (with dates)
Library list filters/sorts by class; picking sets the per-character Active guide
Delete asks for confirmation inside the addon (no StaticPopup) and clears Active guide references
Tests cover Library add/replace/delete/list

userStories.title: Rotation by level
userStories.description: The typed `## Rotation` block is parsed into level-ranged parts (`@ 1-8`, `@ 26+`) and always-shown parts (`@ AoE`, text before the first `@`). The Guide window shows the part for the character's level plus the always-shown parts, with a toggle to show all parts.
acceptanceCriteria: Parser builds Rotation parts and rejects malformed `@` lines with line numbers
PartsForLevel picks the later part on overlap and always includes unranged parts
Guide window updates on PLAYER_LEVEL_UP
Show all toggle reveals every range
Unit tests and smoke test pass

userStories.title: Leveling Path: parse, evaluate and check talent names
userStories.description: The typed `## Talents` block is parsed into Steps with target ranks, `|` choices and `--` comments. The Talents adapter reads the live C_Traits tree into a name to rank/max map. Evaluate marks reached Steps, finds the Next talent, lists off-plan points and unknown names. The import result lists unmatched talent names when the Guide's class matches the character, and says the check is deferred otherwise. The Guide window's Talents Section shows Steps ticked and the Next talent marked.
acceptanceCriteria: Step syntax errors carry line numbers
Next talent = first Step not reached, regardless of level
Choice Steps are reached when any option is
Off-plan lists unplanned talents and ranks above the highest target
Unknown names reported on import (same class) and shown as ?
Name matching ignores case and extra whitespace
Unit tests cover Evaluate scenarios; smoke test uses a stubbed C_Traits

userStories.title: Talent panel docked beside the talent window
userStories.description: When EllesmereUI's classic talent window (EUI_ClassicTalents) or Blizzard's talent window is shown, a Talent panel docks beside it showing the next few Steps with comments, reached Steps ticked, off-plan points and unknown names. It updates when talents change.
acceptanceCriteria: Docks to EUI_ClassicTalents when shown, else Blizzard's talent frame
Hidden when no Active guide or the talent window closes
Updates on TRAIT_CONFIG_UPDATED / talent change events
Smoke test shows the panel next to a stub window

userStories.title: Pin: one pinned Section plus the Next talent line
userStories.description: Each Section header in the Guide window gets a pin button. The Pin shows the pinned Section (Rotation filtered by level) in a resizable, scrolling frame, with an optional Next talent line and a link icon. It opens and closes with its close button, a keybind and `/guide pin`. Position, size, pinned Section and visibility are saved per character.
acceptanceCriteria: Pinning another Section replaces the current one
Next talent line toggles independently and works with no pinned Section
Keybinds appear under Key Bindings > AddOns
State saved in FieldGuideCharDB and restored on login
Smoke test pins a Section and toggles the Pin

userStories.title: Level-up talent notice
userStories.description: On PLAYER_LEVEL_UP the addon prints one chat line naming the Next talent (and target rank), unless the Leveling Path is finished or no talent point is available.
acceptanceCriteria: One line per level-up, using locale strings
No line when the Guide is finished or there is no Active guide
Smoke test fires PLAYER_LEVEL_UP and reads the printed line

userStories.title: References: highlighted names with tooltips
userStories.description: Markup tokenizes `[Name]`, `[spell:id:Name]`, `[item:Name]` and `[item:id:Name]`. Section text shows References in a highlight colour. Hovering shows the game tooltip when the References adapter can resolve it (spell IDs, items with IDs, known spells and talents by name); otherwise it stays a coloured name.
acceptanceCriteria: Tokenizer handles plain text, References and URLs in one line, including brackets that are not References
Resolver chooses tooltip vs plain colour
Hover shows a GameTooltip for resolvable References only
Unit tests for Tokenize and Render; smoke test hovers a Reference

userStories.title: wow-guide-convert skill and the Arcane Mage Solo fixture
userStories.description: A Claude skill in the repo holds the Guide Import spec and the conversion procedure: open the Source page in Chrome, wait for render, list Variants and ask which one, extract that Variant's tabs, write `guides/<class>-<slug>-<variant>.guide.txt`, validate with a LuaJIT CLI that runs the Core ImportParser, and copy to the clipboard. The first conversion is the Mobalytics Arcane Mage Leveling Solo Variant, which becomes a test fixture.
acceptanceCriteria: Skill linked into ~/.claude/skills
Validation CLI prints errors with line numbers and exits non-zero on failure
Arcane Mage Solo import parses with zero errors and is used as a test fixture
Import is placed on the clipboard

userStories.title: Debug report and in-game verification
userStories.description: `/guide debug` writes the Active guide, live talent map, Evaluate result and frame anchors into SavedVariables. The user imports the Arcane Mage fixture in the live client and checks the window, Pin, Talent panel (EllesmereUI) and level-up line; Claude reads the report after `/reload` and fixes mismatches with the stand-in.
acceptanceCriteria: Debug report lines in FieldGuideDB.report
C_Traits talent reading confirmed in the live client
Docking to EUI_ClassicTalents confirmed
api-notes.md in the wow-forever-addon skill updated with verified facts
